signature_moves: Time-as-hero: oversized tabular readout as the emotional center of a menu-bar glance surface
Session sparkline: a 7-bar histogram turns a one-shot timer into a glanceable daily dashboard
Single-accent economy: exactly one saturated action (pause) + one saturated datum (tall bar); all else white-or-muted on navy
defects: Contrast Dilution - 'Tracking...' #3B4559 on #0B1830 = 1.84:1, de-emphasis overshoots into illegibility
Control occludes data - accent pause button overlaps the final digit of '01:24:36', hiding part of the primary readout
Non-native theming (tell, not canon) - hardcoded brand-navy surface + fixed iOS-blue accent instead of system material + controlAccentColor
Low UI contrast - muted histogram bars 2.15:1, under the 3:1 non-text floor (mitigated: decorative)

aesthetic.direction: Neo-grotesque product, dark variant - deep-navy surface + one electric blue accent, consumer coat over a utility core (design-craft: 'committed' cool-blue, restrained accent budget)

psychology: Von Restorff - the lone accent pause button and lone highlighted bar are the remembered elements; single-accent discipline makes them work
Aesthetic-usability effect - the polished dark card buys first-contact trust for a free/open-source utility
Fitts's Law - ~55px pause target is easy to acquire; the small in-content X is comparatively starved
Hierarchy via de-emphasis - correctly applied (time bright, status muted) but overshot on 'Tracking...' into a contrast failure
Peak-End / glanceability (Jakob's Law of menu-bar convention) - the time-as-hero layout serves the 1-second glance the surface exists for
notes: SINGLE marketing composite only; no in-app screenshots supplied (gallery empty). The dark panel is a RENDER, not a captured screenshot, so all geometry is (estimated) and everything is (inferred) - one surface. Do not promote anything from this app alone. Scale reads ~@1x logical (~297pt-wide popover); if the render is @2x the panel would be implausibly small for the content, so @1x assumed. Custom navy surface + fixed iOS-blue accent + in-content X are non-native tells - exclude from macOS native canon; record as tells+corrections. App targets macOS 13+ so era is Big Sur (pre-Liquid-Glass); absence of glass is era-correct, not a defect. The blue-drenched backdrop and two-tone grotesque headline ('Track freelance work,' white + 'from your menu bar' muted #A8BDF1, green #34C759 status dot) are brand/marketing evidence, not app-UI evidence - do not conflate. Icon (blueprint-style stainless watch on a blue drafting-grid squircle, 'F' brandmark) was NOT digested here - Workflow A only; belongs to an icon (Workflow B) pass.
